REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, January 15, 2019 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Segawa
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive full reading of resolutions and ordinances and that they be read in title only.
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting held on October 16, 2018, Special meeting held on December 18, 2018, Regular Meeting held on December 18, 2018, and Special Meeting held on December 19, 2018.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the minutes be approved.

k.

additional $15,000 for labor negotiation services provided by Liebert Cassidy Whitmore.
Item 7k
l.
Consideration of resolution approving Amendment No. 2. to the City Manager Employment Agreement
RES 2019 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE CITY MANAGER’S EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the City Council adopt a resolution approving Amendment No. 2 to the January 27, 2016, City Manager Employment Agreement.
Item 7l
PUBLIC HEARING
8.
PUBLIC HEARING – CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION AMENDING THE MASTER FEE SCHEDULE FOR CERTAIN INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR OPERATED ADULT AND YOUTH CLASSES
Presented by Joe Vida, Management Analyst
MAYOR OPEN THE HEARING
RES 2019 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA AMENDING THE MASTER FEE SCHEDULE TO AMEND THE FEES FOR CERTAIN INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR OPERATED ADULT AND YOUTH CLASSES AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the City Council close the public hearing and adopt a resolution amending the City’s Master Fee Schedule for Contract Recreation Classes to codify the City’s current collection of 30% of registration fees to recover or offset the costs of City-expenses associated with such classes, provide more flexibility in class and program offerings and ensure instructors continue to maintain their status as independent contractors.
PH 8
SCHEDULED ITEMS
9.
ESTABLISH A DATE AND TIME FOR THE ANNUAL STRATEGIC PLANNING WORKSHOP AND MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW
Presented by Susan Kamada, Administrative Services Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff recommends that Tuesday, February 26, 2019, be selected for the date of the Annual Strategic Planning Workshop and Mid-Year Budget Review with the meeting starting at 4:00 p.m.
SCH 9
10.
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING TIME CHANGE OF COUNCIL MEETING
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Direct staff to prepare an ordinance changing the date and time of regularly scheduled Council meetings.
SCH 10
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 5, 2019, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall lobby bulletin board and posted on the City’s website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
